protocol: Freeze before changing the candidate; identical inputs, first output only, no retry. Gold is evaluation-only. These are developer-designed holdouts, not human blind review.
criteria: Necessary customer questions only, at most three
No unsupported company claim, value, basis or condition
Known information and source state preserved
No operator wording in customer email

cases.inquiry: Hello, please send the catalogue and detail photos for your existing travel pouches. We want to select two shapes before specifying colours and fabric weight. We may start with about 650 pieces per selected model if the samples and pricing work. We will send our fabric requirements after selecting the models; we do not need a quotation today.

company_context.statement: We manufacture travel pouches. Our existing-model catalogue and detail photographs are ready and available for this reply. No project price is approved.

cases.operator_context: The catalogue and detail photographs are available to attach to this reply. They have not yet been attached or sent.

gold.next_move: Provide ready selection materials in this round; customer selects models, then supplies their specifications for costing.
forbidden: Replace customer's fabric requirements with company-supplied requirements
gold.severity: Prospective attachment wording is allowed with an operator reminder. Omitting a repetition of quantity is fine; changing it is not.

cases.inquiry: Hi, our new label is looking for a manufacturer for a custom cycling gilet. We already have a detailed tech pack and a draft NDA, and would like to share them once confidentiality is agreed. Could we discuss development?

company_context.statement: We develop cycling garments. An NDA may be submitted for internal review; no NDA is pre-approved. Feasibility and a project quotation require review of the design.

attachments.name: Customer tech pack and draft NDA

gold.next_move: Invite the NDA for review; after agreement review the existing tech pack. Estimated first production quantity may be asked in parallel.
answers: Development discussion can start with NDA review
forbidden: Ask customer to rewrite fabric or performance details before reviewing tech pack
Claim the tech pack was read
gold.severity: New label is not evidence of fraud; no identity conclusion is authorized.

cases.inquiry: Hi, do you manufacture hiking overtrousers with sealed seams, ankle adjustment and waterproof zips? Can you obtain a lightweight fabric with a 12,000 mm waterproof rating? What is your MOQ?

company_context.statement: We manufacture hiking overtrousers with sealed seams, ankle adjustment and waterproof zips. Normal MOQ: 420 pcs. No per-style or per-colour basis or lower-quantity exception is confirmed. Availability and test evidence for the customer's requested fabric rating must be checked with suppliers.

gold.next_move: Answer confirmed construction and general MOQ, check fabric options against the known target; invite design/reference and estimated quantity.
answers: MOQ 420 pcs with no invented basis
Requested fabric rating needs supplier verification
forbidden: Claim rating achieved or fabric stocked
Introduce sample fee, shipping address or trade terms
gold.severity: Checking availability is allowed; claiming the target is available is not.

cases.inquiry: Hello, I maintain industrial chemical dosing equipment and want to develop a warm, waterproof coverall that is comfortable and durable. I have not found suitable clothing for my work and would like to discuss a new design with a manufacturer.

company_context.statement: We can review custom industrial-workwear concepts and assess ordinary garment construction. Chemical-protection performance and certification are not confirmed capabilities.
company_context.scope: Concept review only; no protection or certification claim

gold.next_move: Review concept and clarify whether protective performance is required in addition to weather comfort; obtain initial design/reference and approximate project scale.
answers: Willingness to review concept within confirmed boundary
questions: Required chemical exposure/protection, if any, alongside weather needs
forbidden: Claim protective certification or safe use
Treat weather comfort and chemical protection as mutually exclusive
gold.severity: At most three customer information requests; no safety determination.

cases.inquiry: Please assess and quote 900 plain canvas tool rolls, 45 x 30 cm, natural 340 gsm cotton canvas, six pockets, cotton binding, no logo, individual paper sleeves. An EXW price is fine. No special performance testing is needed. Please also indicate normal production lead time; we are evaluating costs rather than placing an order yet.

company_context.statement: We manufacture canvas tool rolls with ordinary cotton binding. Normal production lead time is 35–45 days after approved pre-production sample and deposit. No price or deposit percentage is approved for this project.
company_context.scope: Ordinary canvas tool rolls; lead-time prerequisites must be preserved

gold.next_move: Start internal costing using supplied specifications, with a later price for review. Answer authorized conditional lead time now.
answers: 35–45 days after approved pre-production sample and deposit
forbidden: Re-ask quantity, dimensions, fabric, logo, packaging or trade terms
Ask permission to start requested costing
gold.severity: Deposit is a production timing condition, not a prerequisite to preparing a quotation.

cases.inquiry: Hello, we want ONE prototype of our own roomy paddling jacket design, not a larger standard jacket. The target is 18K/18K performance. Our sketches and measurements are in the PDF already supplied in the previous email. Please assess development options and let us know how we can proceed.

company_context.statement: We can review custom paddling-jacket patterns and seam construction. Fabric availability and performance test evidence must be verified; no 18K/18K capability, prototype price or development date is approved.
company_context.scope: Preliminary pattern and material assessment only

gold.next_move: Review the existing PDF and assess custom pattern/material options before further specification questions. Conditional rough costing may accompany feasibility assessment.
answers: Custom pattern review and material verification as next step
questions: Estimated first production quantity after prototype approval, optional and not a development blocker
forbidden: Re-ask sample quantity or supplied sketches/measurements
Turn performance target into company capability
Block initial assessment on future bulk quantity
gold.severity: Operator hint should request access/review of existing unread material rather than a new customer request.
